page.overview:
What is Charging array?

A charging array was a device that was used for energy discharge augmentation. The high-capacity charging arrays could be used in military-grade shipboard turbolasers. The freighter Yissira Zyde was carrying 46 such arrays when it was hijacked by the First Order.
